- Validate model quality on your prompt set (intent/slot accuracy + hallucination checks)
- Measure throughput and latency under expected TPS (20 concurrent users, ~250 qps peak)
- Get Redwood recommendations for model/quantization to hit cost + latency goals

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (model fit / evals)

Hi all —

I uploaded the initial benchmark artifacts and a short Redwood-verified performance profile for the candidate models we discussed. Quick answers to Caroline’s questions:

- The attached PDF and Drive folder include both pure inference latency (model-only) and a separate combined run where we add a simulated 40ms retrieval step. Each benchmark artifact is labeled.
- We included basic hallucination/regression checks in the eval suite: field-level exact-match checks for price/size, plus a simple fuzz test for entity hallucination. Full eval scripts are in the Drive folder so you can run locally.

Summary of recommended variants (from lowest-latency to highest-quality):
- redwood-optimized-7b-q4f16: cost-efficient, quantized; median P50 latency 42ms (model-only), P95 110ms, P99 220ms; sustained TPS on our Dedicated profile: ~950 req/s (at 4k context).
- redwood-13b-ggml-8bit: higher accuracy on long prompts, P50 78ms, P95 190ms; TPS ~420 req/s.
- redwood-70b-fp16 (fallback for high-fidelity answers): P50 260ms, P95 520ms; TPS ~90 req/s.

Notes/observations:
- The 7b quantized profile gives the best balance for your SLOs if we keep retrieval separate (40ms). With retrieval, user-perceived P95 is ~150ms.
- We flagged a potential quality regression on the 7b quantized variant for a narrow subset of product descriptions (long nested lists). We included a small prompt set (#prompt_variant_long_lists) in the Drive evals and recommend running that regression check as part of canary testing.

Drive (benchmark artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDEFghIJk-lMnOPQ
Verified profile (web): https://redwood.example.com/profiles/redwood-optimized-7b-q4f16
Eval dashboard: https://redwood.example.com/evals/ACME-4987

Attachments: redwood_acme_benchmarks_2026-08-24.pdf (pdf), prompt_set_acme_v1.jsonl (jsonl)

Happy to jump on the call Tue 8/25 at 10am PT and walk through the artifacts. I’ll demo the regression tests and the rollback plan.

—Marissa
